description:
Filed by s527c (2026-10-31), found by t/op/for.t's first companion run (the file had been a whole-file PPI failure until s527c, #1580).  SILENT WRONG, pre-existing (main ff5f72b5 + vendor dc242138 = the s527c tree): `local *NAME` does NOT hide a scalar that an enclosing `local $NAME = ...` gave a value -- inside the glob-local scope $NAME still reads the outer local's value; perl reads a fresh (undef) scalar.

perl 5.40.3 vs PCL:
  our $foo = "boo"; { local *foo; print defined $foo ? "def [$foo]\n" : "undef\n"; }    perl: undef   PCL: undef   (control: a plain package value IS hidden)
  local $bar = "b"; { local *bar; print defined $bar ? "def [$bar]\n" : "undef\n"; }    perl: undef   PCL: def [b]
  { local $foo = "boo"; { local *foo; for $foo (1,2) {} print defined $foo ? "def\n" : "undef\n"; } }   perl: undef   PCL: def  (t/op/for.t 111 "NULL GvSV", 112 "NULL GvSV int iterator")

Suspect: `local $NAME` dynamically binds the scalar CELL (a let of the special variable), and `local *NAME` swaps the glob's scalar SLOT -- a read of $NAME inside reaches the let-bound value, not the glob's new empty slot.  Cheap discriminating measurement: pl2cl the second line and read whether `local $bar` lowers to a dynamic binding of the cell symbol and `local *bar` to p-local-glob on the glob -- two different places.  ir-spec §7.2 (globs) is the normative text to check.


=== DONE (s530a, 2026-10-31) ===
MECHANISM (the task's suspicion, confirmed by reading the emission): `local $NAME` lowers to p-local-cell, whose body LEXICALLY rebound $NAME to the box it installed -- `(let (($NAME (symbol-global-value '$NAME))) ...)`, there for the string-eval thunk's parameter shadowing -- so a `local *NAME` inside, which gives the glob a fresh scalar in the CELL, was invisible: the body kept reading the hidden box.  The same held for `local @NAME` / `%NAME`.
FIX (cl/ only, emission IDENTICAL): p-local-cell and p-local-cell-if rebind SYM as a SYMBOL MACRO onto the cell -- `(symbol-macrolet ((SYM (sb-ext:symbol-global-value 'SYM))) ...)`, exactly the access p-defcell defines -- so the body reads the cell as code outside it does, and an eval-thunk parameter is still shadowed (eval.t's recursive factorial probed).
PROBES: scratch/s530a/pr/g1.pl (9 rows: the task's three, a write inside the glob-local scope, a sub reading the global, `local *e = \"G"`, `local @arr` + `local *arr`, a ref taken before) + g2.pl (17 rows: string eval incl. the recursive factorial, closures, local-if true / false, %/@ globs, a loop of locals) identical to perl 5.40.3; the base differs on 9 rows of g1.
GUARD: Pl/t/local-glob-01.t rows 16-17 (inverse-verified on 0fb05a79).  Targeted gate 139 files PASS (scratch/s530a/tg3963.log).  Bench localvar (A tree / B base) 0.1733 / 0.1747 s: no cost.
ACCEPTANCE: t/op/for.t rows 111-112 -- see the batch's companion one-file run (session-log s530a).
